The archive's anchor for the census, #1725 (Ils ne sont pas marxistes, AXN:0B50), is read at the passages that name the entity or its kind (archives of the left, organs, holders, splits): its terms organ, holder and route for what a defeated critique keeps are the archive's categories, applied by #1725 to journals, papers, archives and libraries; #1725 also cites three libcom.org pages as its record of the Lotta Continua ending and of the UK SWP's splits. Admission by reading (§3.4): D where a deposit names the entity and says something of it; R where a deposit states a relation between the entity and an archive work (its use as a source of record); O-class where a sentence applies an archive category to one of the two classes; a bare mention, a URL in a reference line or a list of keywords is not a claim.
